content:
maria: Quick run summary — end-to-end perf sweep for mixed-precision (FP8/INT4) on long-context prefill vs streaming decode. Seeing a nasty decode regression when calibration is enabled and the kernel scheduler keeps flipping around the 512–768 token boundary. Posting numbers and notes.

aj: paste the numbers pls

maria: bench table (rw-13B-mix, layerwise quant, seq lens up to 2048):
```
Config   | Mode    | TTFT(ms) | TPS
FP16     | Prefill | 1200     | 8.3
FP8      | Prefill | 820      | 12.1
INT4     | Prefill | 600      | 16.6
FP16     | Decode  | 45/step  | 22.0
FP8      | Decode  | 32/step  | 30.5
INT4     | Decode  | 50/step  | 19.4   <- unexpected slowdown
```

maria: Observations: INT4 prefill looks great, but decode is slower than FP8. Profiling shows extra dequant + KV unpack overhead and a lot of kernel_switch events around mid-long contexts. Also KV cache eviction thrash at >1024 due to current per-shard eviction heuristic.

kevin: per-layer vs per-tensor calib? if calibration mixes formats at runtime we can get wrong fast paths.

sre-jen: perf-bot attached flamegraph and a quick metrics dump.

perf-bot: METRICS: kernel_switch_count=342, kv_evictions=98, avg_deq_ms=1.8, batching_efficiency=0.74, avg_microbatch=6.1

aj: try bumping kernel_hysteresis_ms to 80 and microbatch_threshold to 8; should reduce flip-flop and allow batching to stabilize a single fast kernel. Also try kv_warmup=1 for first request to avoid cold unpacking.

maria: ran with kernel_hysteresis_ms=80 + microbatch_threshold=8 locally: kernel_switch_count -> 12, decode TPS improved to ~28 (was 19.4), still ~8% below FP8 but stable. kv_evictions dropped 75%.

kevin: that matches a hypothesis: scheduler hysteresis + small microbatches cause repeated kernel selection thrash, which magnifies dequant overhead on decode. Two levers: increase hysteresis OR make kernel selection prefer decode-optimized kernels once prefill flagged.

aj: another option: freeze quant params after prefill (calib snapshot) so decode uses fixed scales; avoids per-step re-calibration overhead. Or use hybrid path: quantize FFN but keep KV representation as FP16 to avoid unpack on decode.

maria: good call. I'll run a night job with kv_warmup=1 + per-layer-calib snapshot after prefill and hybrid decode path (FFN quant only). Will report back tomorrow.

aj: :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — posting logs to the perf run thread in case anyone wants to poke: https://internal.redwood/perf/1976543210 (will attach flamegraphs) :raised_hands:
